600.title: Recipe AI examples count only saved recipes, plus a shared pool the platform admin curates
humanItems: Make a recipe with AI from text, change one ingredient in the builder and save it; then, as the platform admin with that business opted in, the recipe appears under "מועמדים" on `/platform` with a kept % below 100.

After merge, from the main folder: `node server/migrations/0012-drop-unscoped-ai-shots.js --target=atlas --confirm-host=<member host>` (dry run) shows the count; the same with `--write=yes` deletes them; `--verify=yes` exits 0.
